status_reason: All automatable M09 work and checks passed on post-review code: the native Hub (Home/History/Diagnostics/Models+Training Data/Settings — one AppKit shell over a headless-testable HubState, single instance, saved frame, close≠quit with state preserved) plus the read-only history query layer (date grouping with the explicit Undated group, escaped text/app/mode search through the single-writer store, distinct source→normalized→cleaned lineage with the transform honestly absent until M11), the Models → Training Data inspector (versioned span/verbatim/intended annotations with the per-example verbatim listen gate, pin scoped away from review retention, exclude/delete-everywhere, honest readiness triad), replay (one at a time, honest unavailability), diagnostics (event stream, job timelines, redacted export), and the coordinator command surface with the focus-steal guard deferring Hub actions during recording, the ⌘V window and any in-flight insertion/undo transaction. Store schema v5 (job_targets + captured index; additive, backed up). Suites: history queries 11/11, training inspector 12/12, diagnostics 3/3, hub shell 14/14 (real coordinator), plus every M01–M08 suite, worker_live, live_pipeline and the V1 control (51/51) re-ran green post-review. The /review-2 → /address loop completed: the corroborated verbatim listen-gate provenance leak, the dead History Retry button and the double-requeue duplicate-insertion path were fixed in-session with regression tests, and every warning was fixed or scoped (repaste attribution, pin/annotation lease separation, retry guards, bounded export, SQL subquery search, json_extract mode filter, SQL-side Home counts, merged-limit fix); deferred items are documented in results.json. Pending is the native human trial (all screens at normal/enlarged scale, keyboard navigation, replay/retry of real samples, move/resize/relaunch, one correct + one incorrect review, a narrow correction, excluded/deleted records disappearing) — it does not gate M10's automatable work.
